target_definition.training_inputs: Only frozen Train Vessels GT and original RGB-derived FOV. No Dev probabilities/errors, H maps, U maps, image-specific weights, endpoints or branch graphs enter the added training target.
target_definition.foreground: G=V & FOV, full native image; raw GT and frozen RGB FOV remain unchanged
target_definition.skeleton: skimage.morphology.skeletonize(G, method='zhang'), no pruning, erosion, dilation, tube expansion or crop-local re-skeletonization
target_definition.train_mask: S_train=skeleton & (radius<=1.5), equivalent to width<=3.0 native pixels, bool mask, subset of G
target_definition.U_policy: Base T0 includes U unchanged. Added target uses only V/FOV and does NOT consult U; valid Train S points in U are retained. Evaluation excludes frozen U for the new skeleton endpoint, just as existing regional support. This intentional train/eval distinction is explicit.
target_definition.geometry: Precompute whole-image S_train once; apply exactly the existing crop,hflip,vflip,CCW_rot90 geometry to RGB,V,FOV,S. No resize, no target-dependent crop/resample and no random-number consumption in target generation.
target_definition.units: Native pixel width proxy, not physical calibre or a definition of all biological capillaries
target_definition.expected_dev_reference: Evaluation uses independently generated Dev GT/FOV-only S3, clipped to Omega after skeletonization; 28 valid images/7291 points. Original near target stays 9 images/77 points/19 NA.

loss.computation_dtype: float32 after unchanged AMP forward; BCEWithLogits/softplus(-z), never log(sigmoid(z))
loss.baseline: Reuse bound T0 masked BCE+unweighted soft Dice implementation WITHOUT changing numeric operation order or smoothing (Dice epsilon=1e-6).
loss.target_count: N_j=sum(S_train_j), integer count after frozen geometry
loss.aux_per_crop: if N_j>0: sum(S_j*BCEWithLogits(z_j,ones))/N_j; else differentiable exact zero with zero auxiliary logits gradient
loss.batch: mean_j(base_BCE_j+base_Dice_j+0.1*aux_j), j=1..4; empty-target crops remain in the four-crop mean
loss.no_implicit_normalization: Do not divide by FOV for aux, pool skeleton counts across batch, average only nonempty crops, multiply the whole T0 loss by a target mask, or modify base BCE denominator/Dice.
loss.lambda_zero: Explicit bypass to original T0 loss, not an approximate implementation; zero-replay numeric operations and gradients must be identical.
loss.empty_FOV: Existing error_no_resampling; an empty skeleton is not an error and does not change sampling.

controls.immutable_numeric: All numeric train settings, architecture, normalization, sample order and augmentation remain equal to baseline_config; max_steps=2000.
controls.initialization: Load only original M0 model parameters; fresh AdamW/AMP/RNG states matching formal T0 start. Do not resume T0/A15.2/4000/M1.
controls.pairing: All 8000 RGB/V/FOV draw tensors, filenames and geometry match formal seed2026 T0 by step/draw. Added S is separately hashed; its construction must not perturb inputs/RNG.

hardware.readiness: 仅使用既有GPU0，在原显存/利用率/无其他计算进程条件满足时运行；繁忙则等待或记录阻塞，不杀他人任务

controls.runtime_budget: Expected 0.5-1 GPU hour; accumulate at most 5400 seconds GPU occupancy for gate training + research + new evaluation, excluding CPU prep and queue. At limit save full state/pause; no automatic extra allocation. Existing safe_stop config is not changed.
controls.storage: Check space before training; require >=20 GiB free in the experiment filesystem, never delete prior outputs to make room.

H1.selection: 12 Train target-definition cases + up to6 Dev old-prediction cases +4 Dev FP cases; all deterministic, pre-candidate, no model forward.
H1.train_cases: Strata native sizes(960x1440,1488x2240,1536x2304) x S3 GT-skeleton endpoint(degree1 in full unpruned 8-neighbor skeleton)/nonendpoint. In each stratum choose two distinct flattened (filename,y,x) ranks floor(.25*(n-1)) and floor(.75*(n-1)); empty/singleton strata recorded, no favorable substitution.
H1.dev_cases: For each of the three native sizes choose lexicographic median (filename,y,x) in full-domain S3 for all11 old conditions miss and all11 hit; unavailable cells recorded, not replaced with another definition.
H1.fp_cases: Formal T0 three-seed mean FP/FOV: two highest and two lowest Dev images, ties filename. Largest existing 8-connected label-relative FP component of seed2026 T0, ties first row-major component; cases are illustrative not biological FP adjudication.
H1.display: 256-native-pixel clamped crop plus full-image context, unmodified RGB/GT/FOV/full skeleton/S3 panels; for Dev add existing predictions. Exact target marker must not hide it; display-only enlargement is not evaluation preprocessing.
H1.pass: All selected available cases actually reviewed by a real researcher with actual identity/time/evidence; all Train overlay/definition alignment confirmed, no unresolved implementation misalignment; overall signed/quoted researcher acceptance of fixed target as usable exploratory supervision. Uncertain visibility/biology is allowed and retained but suspected systematic GT-spur/target-definition failure pauses scientific review. No deleting targets/Dev cases to pass.
H1.truthfulness: AI-filled templates/categories do not satisfy human review. Original PlanB human0/105 remains unchanged unless separately actually reviewed; this stage has its own task-local review evidence. CPU atlas ready -> pause and request real review. Human acceptance after seeing bound cases unlocks already conditionally authorized GPU work, not new arms.

runs.comparison: Original T0 first200 log/input records and stored step_000200.pt; bitwise/equivalent canonical tensor digests for model,AdamW,AMP,RNG,cursor; metadata labels/output paths/time excluded, no tolerance relaxation.

G2.gradients: On fixed real Train crops in engineering first50 record base BCE,Dice,unweighted aux,weighted aux and target count; base/aux logits gradient L1/L2 and ratios, combined preclip parameter gradient norm. Use no extra forward, no optimizer update for diagnostics and no RNG changes.
G2.analytic_check: For batch B=4 and nonempty crop j, d(lambda*L_aux)/dz=0.1*S*(sigmoid(z)-1)/(4*N_j); outside S/empty crop exactly zero. Weighted auxiliary logits L1 <=0.1 across the batch; compare FP32 analytic gradient with rtol1e-5/atol1e-7. All norm/ratios finite or explicitly NA for zero denominator; magnitude ratio alone is not permission to change lambda.
G2.no_dev_during_engineering: No candidate Dev inference, no use of short-run scores for method selection; only fixed Train batches. All engineering states discarded; A1 scientific run starts fresh.

evaluation.reference_order: Generate full native Zhang skeleton/radius on V&FOV before U clipping; eval Omega=FOV&~U. Euclidean d1 includes center and four axial neighbors, excludes diagonal sqrt2. No prediction thinning, dilation other than fixed matching support, closing, pruning or topology repair.

evaluation.original_metrics: Existing seven metrics from the frozen evaluator and all original near/internal/far/U/FOV definitions unchanged; FP density=FP/FOV including U, not FP/background FPR; original near thin remains9 valid/77 positions/19NA.
evaluation.inference: Frozen native tiled patch512,stride256,batch4,AMP false, gaussian blend, no TTA/noresize, original FIVES normalization. All28 Dev each time.

evaluation.probabilities: Retain all10 new evaluation points' native float32 maps (280), counts and source checkpoint SHA. Step0 references existing original-Z0 maps (28), do not overwrite/copy old outputs. Retain all10 complete checkpoints.

evaluation.zero_baseline: Report existing Z0 absolute values through CPU reuse; it is not the new incremental comparator.

statistics.reporting: Both absolute and paired values, all per-image numerators/denominators/NA/improved-worse-tie and leave-one-image influence as descriptive only. Preserve unfavorable and failed conditions; no p-value/point-level significance search.

statistics.uncertainty: Intervals conditional on this M0 and seed2026, image resampling not validated patient sampling; Dev repeatedly used including CPU direction exploration. Prospective freezing cannot erase prior selection bias.

interpretation.primary_clear: Primary paired mean>0 and image-bootstrap95%lower>0, conditional exploratory signal only; mean>0 but CI crosses0=uncertain, not confirmed improvement.
interpretation.original_protection_clear: All simultaneous: precision lowerCI>=0, far_recall lowerCI>=0, fp_density upperCI<=0; no clinical safety/noninferiority claim.
interpretation.original_protection_cost: Mean precision/far below0 or mean FP above0=observed cost; mean on allowed side but interval crosses line=protection evidence insufficient.
interpretation.additional_safety: Point differences of overall Dice and full-image Recall must each be>=0; report their intervals, do not call crossed intervals noninferiority. Mandatory d0 paired mean must not be negative for the 'promising' flag.
interpretation.promising_flag: Primary mean>0, original protection means on allowed sides, Dice/fullRecall/d0 point safety passed; use only to discuss applying for future A2/three-seed authorization. If CIs fail, explicitly uncertain. Never auto-launch another group.
interpretation.protected_exploratory_gain: primary_clear AND original_protection_clear AND additional_safety; still only reused-Dev/one-seed evidence, not independent validation or method success.
interpretation.mechanism: A1 vs T0 alone cannot establish skeleton-specific advantage over generic positive weighting, topology/continuity repair, original TW success, physical vessel recovery or clinical benefit.
interpretation.engineering_completion: Fair, complete, reproducible delivery irrespective of positive/negative/inconclusive scientific result.
